name: fleet-man automation fixture
postCreateCommand:
sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends tmux && mkdir -p $HOME/.local/bin && printf '#!/bin/sh
echo AGENT_RAN $* > /tmp/automation_agent_out
exec sleep 600
' > $HOME/.local/bin/claude && chmod +x $HOME/.local/bin/claude && echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> $HOME/.bashrc
